item.title: SLIPKNOT Says Sid Wilson Is 'No Longer Associated' With Band After Nearly 30 Years
item.description: Sid Wilson is no longer a member of Slipknot, ending a run that stretched across nearly three decades and every studio album released by the Iowa metal band.
